description.zh:
文档库名称。

> 由[CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~)接口创建。您可以调用[ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~)接口查看已经创建的文档库。
description.en:
The name of the document collection.

> You can call the [CreateDocumentCollection](~~2618448~~) operation to create a document collection. and call the [ListDocumentCollections](~~2618452~~) operation to query a list of document collections.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
文档名。

> 可以通过[ListDocuments](~~2618453~~)接口查看文档列表。
description.en:
The name of the document.

> You can call the [ListDocuments](~~2618453~~) operation to query a list of documents.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

> You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace and call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口指定。
description.en:
The password of the namespace.

> The value of this parameter is specified when you call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation.
The region ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-document --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --collection document --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --file-name music.txt --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DescribeDocument --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --FileName 'music.txt' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
